description: Check provider rate-limit runway (5h / weekly / monthly windows) before large or multi-step work. Returns `action`: go (proceed; scope large = quota would go unused, take on more) | land (keep working, checkpoint before each step — never stop a 5h window early, it resets on its own) | wait (actually used up: checkpoint, wait `waitMinutes` or use `alternatives`) | unknown (no data; never guess). Runs locally.

policy.description: max (default) drains short windows fully; conservative = 25%/10% thresholds.

provider.description: Optional harness/provider (claude-code, codex, cursor, anthropic, openai, …). Defaults to the running harness.

name: runway_check
